name: Backup Warden
summary: Copies your server's backups to another place, every night.
description: Uploads each new encrypted backup to your own bucket (checks every 15 minutes; an upload that already exists is skipped). Failures and a stale off-site copy also go to an optional webhook. The page shows the newest backup, lists the off-site copies with a restore command for each, and lets a system administrator press Back up now and send off-site. It asks for backups:read, backups:run (start a backup; it cannot read the backup key) and notify:email.

application.description: Copies each new encrypted server backup to S3-compatible storage within 15 minutes, and can start a backup now.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py backup.py offsite.py && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp main.py backup.py offsite.py index.html backup.js dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/

settings.name: S3_REGION
settings.description: Object storage region (use us-east-1 for MinIO)

settings.name: API_BASE_URL
settings.description: Base URL of this Automaton server's API, for example https://api.example.com

settings.name: NOTIFY_EMAIL_TO
settings.description: Who gets the failure email: administrators (default), owner or project

settings.name: STALE_HOURS
settings.description: Alert when the newest off-site copy is older than this many hours (default 26)

settings.name: RETENTION_DAYS
settings.description: Keep backups newer than this many days (default 30)

settings.name: MIN_BACKUPS
settings.description: Always keep at least this many newest backups (default 7)

settings.name: S3_PREFIX
settings.description: Optional folder for this install's copies; empty uses automaton/<server host>/<app ID>/

secrets.name: WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Optional https address (Slack, Discord, Telegram or any URL) that also gets each failure and stale alert, even when the server's mail is down
